rationale: C05 provides a close one-sentence delegation template: “I hereby delegate to” a named Secretary “the authority vested in the President by” a specified statute, followed by the particular delegated function. The child reproduces that wording and operative sequence while substituting the Secretary of Defense, the Uniform Code of Military Justice, and authority concerning general courts-martial. C03 is similarly close but contains a more elaborate two-part delegation. C06 concerns the same recipient and military sphere, but uses the less similar passive formulation “There is hereby delegated.”

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hereby delegate to the Secretary of Defense the authority, vested in the President by the Uniform Code of Military Justice, Article 22 (a) (7), to empower any officer...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hereby delegate to the Secretary of State and to any Assistant Secretary of State designated by him the authority vested in the President by Title V of the Foreign Economic Assistance Act of 1950...
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same compact operative formula: first-person delegation to specified executive officials, identification of authority vested in the President by a named statute, and immediate specification of the delegated function.
